(async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/settings', {headers: {connection: 'close'}}); const body = await r.json(); const value = body.data.find((item) => item.key === 'device_transport')?.value; if (value !== 'ble') throw Error('device_transport not saved: ' + value); const d = await (await fetch('/api/diagnostics', {headers: {connection: 'close'}})).json(); if (d.data.transport.setting !== 'ble' || d.data.transport.thresholdBytes !== 1048576) throw Error('diagnostics transport mismatch: ' + JSON.stringify(d.data.transport)); return d.data.transport; })()
